channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Netflix Treats GPU Reliability as a Distributed Systems Problem
item.description: Netflix has detailed how it is building a reliability platform for large-scale GPU training and inference, using layered health checks, automated remediation, and fault-tolerant training to keep jobs running despite hardware failures. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: DoorDash Cuts Grocery Reorder Latency from 16 to 2 Seconds with AI Agents
item.description: DoorDash reduced grocery reorder latency from 16 to 2 seconds by precomputing recurring purchase needs using batch LLM inference and deterministic validation. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
item.description: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026 as attackers shifted to shorter, high-frequency strikes. Explore the latest threat data, including the collapse of CLDAP vectors and the impact of recent botnet takedowns. (1 source: cloudflare)
